title: Sequential Pricing Mechanisms for Surplus Division
abstract: arXiv:2609.02773v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Extending the Price-and-Choose (P&C) mechanism of Echenique and Nunez (2025), we propose the Price-Accept-and-Choose (PA&C) mechanism, which preserves efficiency while eliminating P&C's first-mover advantage. We then analyze randomized and bidding variants and show that the resulting equilibrium payoffs correspond to standard solutions in transferable utility games: the Center of the Imputation Set value for P&C and the Shapley value for PA&C. In the randomized variants, these solutions arise in expectation; in the bidding variants, they are implemented on every equilibrium path. We further relate other efficient designs, such as balanced VCG payments, to additional solution concepts, forging an interpretable bridge between implementation theory and cooperative game theory.

translated_title: 剩余分配的序贯定价机制
translated_abstract: 在Echenique和Nunez（2025）提出的“定价与选择”机制基础上，我们提出了“定价-接受与选择”机制，该机制在保持效率的同时消除了P&C机制的先动优势。随后我们分析了随机化变体和竞价变体，并证明由此产生的均衡收益对应于可转移效用博弈中的标准解概念：P&C机制对应分配集中心值，PA&C机制对应Shapley值。在随机化变体中，这些解以期望形式出现；在竞价变体中，它们在每一条均衡路径上都能被实施。我们进一步将其他有效机制设计（如平衡的VCG支付）与其他解概念联系起来，在实施理论与合作博弈论之间架起了一座可解释的桥梁。
tldr: 本文提出了一种消除先动优势同时保持效率的“定价-接受与选择”机制，并证明其均衡收益对应于Shapley值，从而在实施理论与合作博弈论之间建立了可解释的联系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Price-Accept-and-Choose mechanism, which eliminates the first-mover advantage while preserving efficiency, and shows its equilibrium payoffs correspond to the Shapley value, forging an interpretable bridge between implementation theory and cooperative game theory.
